kb-routing.summary: the KB, its routing protocol and kb-lint in CI

assumption-ledger.summary: Phase 1 exits on a checked assumption ledger

plan-shape.summary: plan steps with tier, checking commands and proof sketch

ratchet.summary: what passed stays passed; suite-level obligations are an acceptable start

human-checkpoints.summary: Inbrief and Backbrief checkpoints with human evidence

writing-standard.summary: STE writing rules on plans, reports and the changelog

project-rules.summary: the engineer's rules about the project live in kb/conventions/method.md, not in agent memory

outcome-acceptance.trigger: the product has users whose observed outcome decides acceptance

project-ledger.trigger: more than one task or feedback source is tracked at a time

concurrent-agents.trigger: several agents write in parallel on one machine

team-collaboration.trigger: agents run on several machines or under several engineers

roadmap.trigger: Full-tier work, or a project that needs more than one slice

critical-core.trigger: some output has a high cost of error (money, data, safety, irreversible)

formal-assurance.trigger: a declared kernel is stable and a test sample does not bound its cost of error

architecture-review.trigger: three or more components, or a project that needs more than one slice

observability.trigger: code that runs in production and logs

external-sources.trigger: a team channel, feedback channel or issue tracker discusses the project

case-leak.trigger: declared acceptance cases decide whether a change is delivered

release-notice.summary: user-level hook that reports new kit releases

memory-route.summary: user-level hook that routes project rules saved to agent memory into the KB
